kind: executed synthetic reference model, not Core implementation
scope: finite sequence/window/input/expiry and authorized aggregation arithmetic

checks.assertion: Fresh input begins a15second finite cue
Renewal extends liveness but preserves fresh-input frontier
Replay does not renew any deadline
Stop ends the episode; old Start cannot revive it
Ordinary renew cannot restart a stopped episode
Fresh input can start a new episode in a valid current instance
Older Stop cannot clear a newer episode
Keepalive never extends beyond last input+30s
Old Start cannot use a window refreshed by unrelated heartbeat
At window equality a command is expired
ACK reconciliation is read-only and cannot renew freshness
Purged unknown instance cannot be recreated by a late update
Current authorization denial rejects otherwise valid intent
Old snapshot expiry is anchored to request start, not arrival
Peer deadline shorter than snapshot trust wins
Expired snapshot cannot gain freshness on a late arrival
Multiple tabs dedupe only after source permission; one expiry does not clear other
No names remain after the last eligible contribution expires
